lesson: Rodriguez Zapatero was correctly ranked first. The surname-form resolution confirms that full-name variants can still capture the intended person, but the direct political-role evidence could have supported more than 60%.
Jansa resolved correctly. Coalition arithmetic and party leadership were more predictive than the appeal of a less polarising alternative, although Logar remained a credible hedge.
Maresca resolved correctly after Alonso's Chelsea appointment removed the main alternative. Manager succession markets reward rapid elimination of candidates who accept incompatible jobs.
Blanche resolved correctly at high confidence. His acting-attorney-general role and direct ownership of the policy outweighed generic cabinet-level alternatives.
Bunia resolved correctly. Field-team deployment and cargo-routing evidence successfully distinguished the operational destination from Kinshasa's laboratory and dispatch role.
Burnham resolved correctly at 96%. Explicit succession reporting justified near-complete concentration.
Jones resolved correctly. The late Trump tele-rally and exclusive endorsement were decisive evidence for a Republican runoff electorate.
Bottoms resolved correctly. Her durable frontrunner status and polling lead outweighed the large undecided share, though 66% appropriately retained runoff uncertainty.
